summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Smart Decision AI after critical fixes. Backend API endpoints are fully functional (100% success rate). Frontend wizard flow works correctly with improved per-option testids for question interactions. However, AI analysis endpoint still experiences intermittent 502 timeouts during complex analysis requests.

action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Fix AI analysis endpoint timeout issues. The 45-second timeout and fallback to Claude Haiku are not sufficient for complex analysis requests with multiple questions. Consider: (1) Increasing timeout beyond 45s, (2) Optimizing AI prompt to reduce processing time, (3) Implementing progressive analysis with intermediate results, or (4) Adding request queuing for complex analyses.
